selection_method.broad: Within each preregistered framework stratum, included candidates were sorted by immutable target SHA (repo as tie-break) and sampled to fixed counts before any HorusTrace execution.
selection_method.rationale: Uses only preregistered stratum and immutable source identity; security richness and deployment evidence did not determine broad-cohort inclusion.

stratum_exceptions.reason: Exhaustive source screening found only three defensible evalstate FastAgent applications; discovery hits were dominated by catalogs, analysis, specifications, documentation and unrelated FastAgent names. Criteria were not weakened.

tier_b_selection.method: Source-observed Tier-B eligibility only; within framework rank by number of preregistered security-complexity signals then immutable SHA.

tier_c_shortfall.reason: After complete 381-repository screening and a dedicated deployment/IAM source review, only four defensible deployment-identity cases survived the independently selected broad cohort. The methodology preregisters this scarcity as a reportable result; no weak cases were promoted to satisfy the target.

limitations: automated source reference is not a substitute for independent human dual adjudication
precision is reported only where reference completeness is explicitly established

metadata_corrections.reason: Pre-baseline source review found application-path metadata errors at the already frozen repo/SHA; paths corrected without changing selection, framework, or target revision.
